title: Finite etale chart and overlap pieces glue to a separated etale base change
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Choose a finite affine open covering $U=\bigcup_{a=1}^mU_a$. Then there is a finite partition $X=\coprod_iX_i$ by constructible locally closed affine subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset] such that every $U_a\times_XX_i\to X_i$ and every $(U_a\cap U_b)\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and $U\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is separated for each $i$. All fibre products are those of [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, second paragraph, lines 12045-12060: finite affine cover, common refinement of the separated case for charts and overlaps, affine refinement, and the affine gluing criterion for separatedness

proof.text: Notation: for $a,b$ write $U_{ab}=U_a\cap U_b$, an open subscheme of $U$ (so $U_{aa}=U_a$). The base $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated: $X\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$ is quasi-compact (if $\operatorname{Spec}R=\bigcup_\lambda D(f_\lambda)$, the $f_\lambda$ generate the unit ideal, so finitely many do and the corresponding $D(f_\lambda)$ cover), and $X\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is a morphism of affine schemes, hence affine, hence quasi-separated. Each $U_a\to X$ (the restriction $j|_{U_a}$) is a morphism of affine schemes, hence affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], hence quasi-compact and separated. The open immersion $U_{ab}\to U_a$ is separated (an immersion), so the composite $U_{ab}\to U_a\to X$ is separated. $U_{ab}$ is quasi-compact: the open immersion $U_a\to U$ has affine (so quasi-compact) source and quasi-separated target, so it is quasi-compact, and $U_{ab}$ is the preimage of the affine open $U_b$ under it; hence $U_{ab}\to X$ is quasi-compact (quasi-compact source, quasi-separated target). Finally $U_{ab}\to X$ is the composite of the open immersion $U_{ab}\to U$ (etale) with the etale $j$, hence etale. So each of the finitely many morphisms $g\in F:=\{U_{ab}\to X: 1\le a\le b\le m\}$ is a separated, quasi-compact etale morphism with quasi-compact source over the quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme $X$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'Choose a finite affine open covering $U=\bigcup U_j$. Apply the previous case to all the morphisms $U_j\to X$ and $U_j\cap U_{j'}\to X$' (that these morphisms are separated, etale and quasi-compact is left implicit)

proof.text: For each $g:W_g\to X$ in $F$ the separated case gives a finite partition of $X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes, i.e. immersions $\iota^g_k:Z^g_k\to X$ ($k<n_g$) whose images $X^g_k$ are pairwise disjoint, constructible and locally closed and cover $X$, with $W_g\times_XZ^g_k\to Z^g_k$ finite etale for every $k$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'Apply the previous case to all the morphisms $U_j\to X$ and $U_j\cap U_{j'}\to X$' (previous case: More on Morphisms, Lemma 07RZ)

proof.text: Common refinement. Enumerate $F=\{g_1,\dots,g_N\}$ and apply the common refinement of stratifications $N-1$ times: its strata are indexed by tuples $\underline k=(k_1,\dots,k_N)$, with scheme $T_{\underline k}=Z^{g_1}_{k_1}\times_X\cdots\times_XZ^{g_N}_{k_N}$, immersion $\iota_{\underline k}:T_{\underline k}\to X$ (the projection to $Z^{g_1}_{k_1}$ followed by $\iota^{g_1}_{k_1}$) and image $\bigcap_sX^{g_s}_{k_s}$ (empty strata may be dropped). These images are pairwise disjoint, cover $X$, are locally closed, and are constructible as finite intersections of constructible sets (the constructible subsets form a Boolean algebra). For each $s$, $\iota_{\underline k}$ factors as the projection $\pi_s:T_{\underline k}\to Z^{g_s}_{k_s}$ followed by $\iota^{g_s}_{k_s}$, so $W_{g_s}\times_XT_{\underline k}\cong(W_{g_s}\times_XZ^{g_s}_{k_s})\times_{Z^{g_s}_{k_s}}T_{\underline k}$ over $T_{\underline k}$ (transitivity of fibre products), which is finite etale over $T_{\underline k}$ as a base change of a finite etale morphism.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'choose a common refinement $X=\coprod X_i$ of the resulting partitions'

proof.text: Affine refinement. Each $\iota_{\underline k}:T_{\underline k}\to X$ is an immersion into the affine scheme $X$ with constructible image, so there are finitely many affine schemes $T_{\underline k,l}$ with immersions $\kappa_{\underline k,l}:T_{\underline k,l}\to T_{\underline k}$ such that the composites $\iota_{\underline k}\circ\kappa_{\underline k,l}$ are immersions with pairwise disjoint, locally closed, constructible images covering $\iota_{\underline k}(T_{\underline k})$. Let $(X_i\to X)_i$ be the finite family of all these $\iota_{\underline k}\circ\kappa_{\underline k,l}$: their images are pairwise disjoint (pieces of one stratum are disjoint, and pieces of different strata lie in disjoint strata) and cover $X$, so this is a finite partition of $X$ by constructible locally closed affine subschemes. For $X_i=T_{\underline k,l}$ and every $g\in F$, $W_g\times_XX_i\cong(W_g\times_XT_{\underline k})\times_{T_{\underline k}}X_i$ is finite etale over $X_i$ as a base change of the finite etale $W_g\times_XT_{\underline k}\to T_{\underline k}$ (step 3). Thus every $U_a\times_XX_i\to X_i$ and every $U_{ab}\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is finite etale (for $a>b$ use $U_{ab}=U_{ba}$).

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'After refining the partition further we may assume $X_i$ affine as well.'

proof.text: Charts and overlaps over a stratum. Fix $i$, let $p:V=U\times_XX_i\to U$ be the first projection and $V_a=p^{-1}(U_a)$. Applied to the open subschemes $U_{ab}\subseteq U$ and $X_i\subseteq X_i$, the open fibre product lemma identifies $U_{ab}\times_XX_i$, compatibly with the projections to $X_i$, with the open subscheme $p^{-1}(U_{ab})=V_a\cap V_b$ of $V$; in particular $V_a\cong U_a\times_XX_i$, and the $V_a$ cover $V$ since the $U_a$ cover $U$. By step 4, $V_a\to X_i$ and $V_a\cap V_b\to X_i$ are finite etale. A finite morphism is affine, so, $X_i$ being affine, $V_a$ and $V_a\cap V_b$ are affine schemes, and $V_a\to X_i$ is separated (affine morphisms are separated). The identity of $X_i$ is a closed immersion, hence proper, so the finite morphism $V_a\cap V_b\to X_i$ is proper (a finite morphism followed by a proper one is proper).

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'The morphisms $V_j=U_j\times_XX_i\to X_i$ and $V_{jj'}=(U_j\cap U_{j'})\times_XX_i\to X_i$ are finite etale. Hence $V_j$ and $V_{jj'}$ are affine schemes'

proof.text: Overlaps are closed in the charts. The inclusion $e:V_a\cap V_b\to V_a$ is a morphism over $X_i$ from the proper $X_i$-scheme $V_a\cap V_b$ to the separated $X_i$-scheme $V_a$, so $e$ is proper. Being an open immersion, $e$ is an immersion; a proper immersion is a closed immersion (its image is closed). Since $V_a$ is affine, the closed immersion $e$ induces a surjection $\mathcal O_V(V_a)\to\mathcal O_V(V_a\cap V_b)$ on global sections (the restriction map). Hence the ring map $\mathcal O_V(V_a)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathcal O_V(V_b)\to\mathcal O_V(V_a\cap V_b)$, $x\otimes y\mapsto x|\cdot y|$, is surjective: already its restriction to the elements $x\otimes1$ is the surjective restriction map.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: '$V_{jj'}\subset V_j$ is closed as well as open (since $V_{jj'}\to X_i$ is proper, so Morphisms, Lemma 01W6 applies) ... $\mathcal O(V_j)\to\mathcal O(V_{jj'})$ is surjective'

proof.text: Separatedness. $V=\bigcup_aV_a$ is a covering by affine opens whose pairwise intersections $V_a\cap V_b$ are affine with $\mathcal O_V(V_a)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathcal O_V(V_b)\to\mathcal O_V(V_a\cap V_b)$ surjective (steps 5 and 6), over the affine scheme $X_i$; by the affine-cover criterion for separatedness, $V=U\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is separated. Together with step 4 this proves the lemma.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 03S9 (etale-cohomology.tex 12035-12061), 01KP (schemes.tex 4157) and the cited nodes. Statement kept. Proof written in 7 steps following the second paragraph of the 03S9 proof: (1) charts U_a and overlaps U_a cap U_b are separated, quasi-compact and etale over the qcqs affine X (left implicit in Stacks); (2) separated case on each; (3) common refinement via the fibre-product construction of lemma-constructible-common-refinement, with constructibility of intersections and finite-etale base change; (4) affine refinement, new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-immersion-affine-constructible-pieces; (5) V_a, V_a cap V_b affine, overlaps identified via lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product, finite implies proper; (6) inclusion of the overlap is proper (proper-over-separated) and an open immersion, hence a closed immersion (01W6 route), giving surjective restriction on global sections; (7) Stacks 01KP(2) over affine base, new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-separated-affine-cover-criterion. The separated-case node lem-weil-pbc-etale-separated-stratified-finite lacks the hypothesis that f be quasi-compact (without it the statement is false: an infinite disjoint union of copies of Y); here it is applied only to quasi-compact morphisms.

reviewed.note: Seven steps along Stacks 03S9 second paragraph: charts and overlaps separated quasi-compact etale over the affine X, the separated case (committed node, hypothesis qc satisfied), common refinement by fibre products of strata, affine refinement (new unsplit node: an immersion with constructible image in an affine scheme splits into finitely many affine constructible pieces), V_a and V_a cap V_b affine and finite over X_i, overlaps closed in charts (proper immersion = closed immersion, leaf of sk-thm-chow; global sections surjective), separatedness by 01KP(2) over an affine base (new unsplit node, a correct specialization). Correct.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_affine_cover_stratification {X U : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U] (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] (m : ℕ) (A : Fin m → U.Opens) (hA : ∀ a : Fin m, IsAffineOpen (A a)) (hcover : ⨆ a : Fin m, A a = ⊤) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ i : Fin n, S i ⟶ X), (∀ i : Fin n, IsAffine (S i) ∧ IsImmersion (ι i) ∧ Topology.IsConstructible (Set.range (ι i))) ∧ Pairwise (fun i k : Fin n ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (ι i)) (Set.range (ι k))) ∧ (⋃ i : Fin n, Set.range (ι i)) = Set.univ ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n) (a : Fin m), IsFinite (pullback.snd ((A a).ι ≫ j) (ι i)) ∧ Etale (pullback.snd ((A a).ι ≫ j) (ι i))) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n) (a b : Fin m), IsFinite (pullback.snd ((A a ⊓ A b).ι ≫ j) (ι i)) ∧ Etale (pullback.snd ((A a ⊓ A b).ι ≫ j) (ι i))) ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, IsSeparated (pullback.snd j (ι i)))
